// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
// Event listeners.
// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

class SliderChangeListener : public Rml::EventListener {
public:
    explicit SliderChangeListener(const SliderDef* def) : m_def(def) {}

    void ProcessEvent(Rml::Event& event) override {
        if (!m_def) return;
        // The widget dispatches "change" BEFORE it stores the new value into
        // the "value" attribute, so the attribute is still the previous step
        // when this runs. Reading it made syncSliders write the stale value
        // back every frame: the knob rubber-banded during drags and released
        // one step short of the track end (100% was unreachable). The event
        // parameter carries the actual new value.
        const Rml::Dictionary& parameters = event.GetParameters();
        const auto it = parameters.find("value");
        if (it != parameters.end()) {
            SetVisualParam(m_def->param, paramFromDom(*m_def, it->second.Get<float>()));
            return;
        }
        Rml::Element* element = event.GetCurrentElement();
        if (!element) return;
        const Rml::Variant* value = element->GetAttribute("value");
        if (!value) return;
        SetVisualParam(m_def->param, paramFromDom(*m_def, value->Get<float>()));
    }

private:
    const SliderDef* m_def;
};

class MenuClickListener : public Rml::EventListener {
public:
    void ProcessEvent(Rml::Event& event) override;
};

MenuClickListener g_clickListener;
std::vector<std::unique_ptr<SliderChangeListener>> g_sliderListeners;
std::vector<std::unique_ptr<class WindowListener>> g_winListeners;

// Height the window renders at right now: the interpolated value while a
// fold animation is running, otherwise the settled folded/unfolded height.
float currentWinH(const WinState& win) {
    if (win.animActive) return win.animH;
    return win.folded ? kFoldedHeight : win.shownH;
}

void applyWin(WinState& win) {
    if (!win.el) return;
    win.el->SetProperty("left", Rml::CreateString("%dpx", static_cast<int>(win.x + 0.5f)));
    win.el->SetProperty("top", Rml::CreateString("%dpx", static_cast<int>(win.y + 0.5f)));
    win.el->SetProperty("width", Rml::CreateString("%dpx", static_cast<int>(win.w + 0.5f)));
    win.el->SetProperty("height", Rml::CreateString("%dpx", static_cast<int>(
        currentWinH(win) + 0.5f)));
}

// Begin (or reverse mid-flight) the fold/unfold animation towards the
// window's current folded target. The start height is passed in by the
// caller, which must capture it BEFORE flipping the folded flag (otherwise
// the start would equal the target). The "folding" class keeps the body
// visible and scroll-locked for the duration.
void startWinAnim(WinState& win, float from) {
    if (!win.el) return;
    const float to = win.folded ? kFoldedHeight : win.shownH;
    if (std::fabs(to - from) < 0.5f) {
        win.animActive = false;
        win.el->SetClass("folding", false);
        win.el->SetClass("folded", win.folded);
        applyWin(win);
        return;
    }
    win.animFrom = from;
    win.animTo = to;
    win.animH = from;
    win.animStart = GetTickCount();
    win.animActive = true;
    win.el->SetClass("folding", true);
    applyWin(win);
}

// Advance every running fold animation. GetTickCount wraps after 49 days;
// the unsigned subtraction still measures short deltas correctly across the
// wrap.
void stepWindowAnims() {
    if (!g_menuShown) {
        for (WinState& win : g_win) {
            if (win.animActive) {
                win.animActive = false;
                if (win.el) win.el->SetClass("folding", false);
            }
        }
        return;
    }
    bool any = false;
    for (WinState& win : g_win)
        if (win.animActive) any = true;
    if (!any) return;
    const DWORD now = GetTickCount();
    for (WinState& win : g_win) {
        if (!win.animActive || !win.el) continue;
        const float t = clamp01(static_cast<float>(now - win.animStart) /
                                static_cast<float>(kFoldAnimMs));
        const float eased = t * (2.0f - t);  // ease-out quad
        win.animH = win.animFrom + (win.animTo - win.animFrom) * eased;
        if (t >= 1.0f) {
            win.animActive = false;
            win.el->SetClass("folding", false);
        }
        applyWin(win);
    }
}

void focusWin(WinState& win) {
    for (WinState& other : g_win)
        if (other.el) other.el->SetClass("focus", &other == &win);
    win.el->SetProperty("z-index", Rml::CreateString("%d", ++g_zTop));
}

// Tile the windows from the shared, harness-verified layout math. force
// re-tilts everything (initial layout, "reset layout" button); otherwise
// windows the user dragged keep their position and are only clamped back
// into the viewport. While the 3D preview is on, a strip on the right is
// reserved for the compat layer's preview window.
void layoutWindows(float viewW, float viewH, bool force) {
    // The document body carries the dim backdrop; it only paints over the
    // area its box covers, and with nothing but absolutely-positioned
    // children that box would be zero-sized. Size it to the viewport.
    if (Rml::Element* body = g_menuDoc->GetElementById("doc-body")) {
        body->SetProperty("width", Rml::CreateString("%dpx", static_cast<int>(viewW + 0.5f)));
        body->SetProperty("height", Rml::CreateString("%dpx", static_cast<int>(viewH + 0.5f)));
    }
    const float inset = g_previewOn.load(std::memory_order_relaxed) &&
        viewW > kPreviewInsetPx * 2.0f ? kPreviewInsetPx : 0.0f;
    float natW[kWindowCount];
    float natH[kWindowCount];
    menu_layout::WindowRect rects[kWindowCount];
    for (int i = 0; i < kWindowCount; ++i) {
        natW[i] = g_win[i].w;
        natH[i] = g_win[i].h;
    }
    menu_layout::computeMenuWindows(natW, natH, kWindowCount, viewW, viewH, rects, inset);
    for (int i = 0; i < kWindowCount; ++i) {
        WinState& win = g_win[i];
        if (!win.el) continue;
        // Re-tiling retargets the geometry; a running fold animation would
        // chase a stale height, so animations are settled here.
        if (win.animActive) {
            win.animActive = false;
            win.el->SetClass("folding", false);
        }
        if (force || !win.dragged) {
            if (force) win.dragged = false;
            win.x = rects[i].x;
            win.y = rects[i].y;
        }
        win.shownH = rects[i].h;
        menu_layout::WindowRect clamped{win.x, win.y, win.w,
                                        win.folded ? kFoldedHeight : win.shownH};
        menu_layout::clampDraggedWindow(clamped, viewW, viewH);
        win.x = clamped.x;
        win.y = clamped.y;
        applyWin(win);
    }
}

// Keep every window where the user left it, only pushing it back inside the
// viewport (and out of the preview strip when the preview is on). Used when
// the 3D preview toggles, so switching it never visibly re-arranges the
// windows.
void clampWindowsToViewport() {
    const float viewW = static_cast<float>(g_width);
    const float viewH = static_cast<float>(g_height);
    const float inset = g_previewOn.load(std::memory_order_relaxed) &&
        viewW > kPreviewInsetPx * 2.0f ? kPreviewInsetPx : 0.0f;
    for (WinState& win : g_win) {
        if (!win.el) continue;
        if (win.animActive) {
            win.animActive = false;
            win.el->SetClass("folding", false);
        }
        menu_layout::WindowRect clamped{win.x, win.y, win.w, currentWinH(win)};
        menu_layout::clampDraggedWindow(clamped, viewW - inset, viewH);
        win.x = clamped.x;
        win.y = clamped.y;
        applyWin(win);
    }
}

// Title-bar drag + focus. Attached to the window (mousedown: focus, bring to
// front) and to the title bar (dragstart/drag: move, clamped so the bar can
// never leave the screen).
class WindowListener : public Rml::EventListener {
public:
    explicit WindowListener(WinState* win) : m_win(win) {}

    void ProcessEvent(Rml::Event& event) override {
        if (!m_win || !m_win->el) return;
        const Rml::EventId id = event.GetId();
        if (id == Rml::EventId::Mousedown) {
            focusWin(*m_win);
            return;
        }
        if (id == Rml::EventId::Dragstart) {
            focusWin(*m_win);
            m_win->grabDx = event.GetParameter<float>("mouse_x", 0.0f) - m_win->x;
            m_win->grabDy = event.GetParameter<float>("mouse_y", 0.0f) - m_win->y;
            return;
        }
        if (id == Rml::EventId::Drag) {
            m_win->x = event.GetParameter<float>("mouse_x", 0.0f) - m_win->grabDx;
            m_win->y = event.GetParameter<float>("mouse_y", 0.0f) - m_win->grabDy;
            m_win->dragged = true;
            menu_layout::WindowRect clamped{m_win->x, m_win->y, m_win->w,
                                            currentWinH(*m_win)};
            menu_layout::clampDraggedWindow(clamped, static_cast<float>(g_width),
                                            static_cast<float>(g_height));
            m_win->x = clamped.x;
            m_win->y = clamped.y;
            applyWin(*m_win);
        }
    }

private:
    WinState* m_win;
};

void MenuClickListener::ProcessEvent(Rml::Event& event) {
    // Walk up from the click target to the nearest element with an id: clicks
    // land on the check mark span, the fold glyph spans, etc.
    Rml::Element* element = event.GetTargetElement();
    while (element && element->GetId().empty()) element = element->GetParentNode();
    if (!element || !g_menuDoc) return;
    const Rml::String id = element->GetId();

    if (id == "btn-close") {
        g_hiddenByClose.store(true, std::memory_order_relaxed);
        return;
    }
    if (id == "btn-hudeditor") {
        g_hudEditorRequest.store(true, std::memory_order_relaxed);
        g_hiddenByClose.store(true, std::memory_order_relaxed);
        return;
    }
    if (id == "sw-preview") {
        const bool on = !g_previewOn.load(std::memory_order_relaxed);
        g_previewOn.store(on, std::memory_order_relaxed);
        if (g_previewSwitch) g_previewSwitch->SetClass("on", on);
        // v7: toggling the preview keeps every window where it is (the user
        // complained the windows "jump together" on re-tiling); only clamp
        // them away from the reserved strip / screen edges.
        clampWindowsToViewport();
        return;
    }
    if (id.size() >= 4 && id.compare(0, 4, "sec-") == 0) {
        // Only the section head toggles the fold. Clicks inside the body
        // (slider labels, rows, padding) used to walk up to the section and
        // collapse it mid-interaction, which made the sliders feel dead.
        Rml::Element* target = event.GetTargetElement();
        bool inHead = false;
        for (Rml::Element* e = target; e; e = e->GetParentNode())
            if (e->IsClassSet("sec-head")) { inHead = true; break; }
        if (inHead) {
            if (Rml::Element* section = g_menuDoc->GetElementById(id)) {
                const bool folded = !section->IsClassSet("folded");
                section->SetClass("folded", folded);
            }
        }
        return;
    }
    if (id.size() == 6 && id.compare(0, 5, "fold-") == 0 && id[5] >= '0' && id[5] <= '9') {
        const int index = id[5] - '0';
        if (index < kWindowCount && g_win[index].el) {
            WinState& win = g_win[index];
            const float fromH = currentWinH(win);
            win.folded = !win.folded;
            win.el->SetClass("folded", win.folded);
            focusWin(win);
            startWinAnim(win, fromH);
        }
        return;
    }
    if (id == "btn-layout") {
        layoutWindows(static_cast<float>(g_width), static_cast<float>(g_height), true);
        return;
    }
    if (const SwitchDef* def = findSwitch(id)) {
        applySwitch(*def, !readSwitch(*def));
        return;
    }
}

// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
// Fonts and documents.
// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

bool loadFontBuffer(const char* path, std::vector<char>& out) {
    std::FILE* file = std::fopen(path, "rb");
    if (!file) return false;
    std::fseek(file, 0, SEEK_END);
    const long size = std::ftell(file);
    std::fseek(file, 0, SEEK_SET);
    if (size <= 0) {
        std::fclose(file);
        return false;
    }
    out.resize(static_cast<std::size_t>(size));
    const std::size_t read = out.empty() ? 0 : std::fread(out.data(), 1, out.size(), file);
    std::fclose(file);
    return read == out.size();
}

// LoadDocumentFromMemory does not fetch external style sheets, so the RCSS is
// injected into the document's empty <style> element before parsing.
Rml::ElementDocument* loadDocumentWithStyle(Rml::Context* context, const char* rml,
                                            const char* rcss, const char* sourceName) {
    std::string text(rml);
    const std::size_t start = text.find("<style>");
    if (start != std::string::npos) {
        const std::size_t end = text.find("</style>", start);
        if (end != std::string::npos) {
            text.insert(start + 7, "\n");
            text.insert(start + 8, rcss);
            text.insert(start + 8 + std::strlen(rcss), "\n");
        }
    }
    Rml::ElementDocument* document = context->LoadDocumentFromMemory(Rml::String(text), sourceName);
    if (!document) return nullptr;
    document->Hide();
    // The context owns the document (it is a child of the context root), so
    // the returned pointer stays valid for the context's lifetime.
    return document;
}

bool buildRegistry() {
    if (!g_menuDoc) return false;
    g_ttStatus = g_menuDoc->GetElementById("tt-status");
    g_ttDiag = g_menuDoc->GetElementById("tt-diag");
    g_previewSwitch = g_menuDoc->GetElementById("sw-preview");
    if (!g_ttStatus || !g_ttDiag || !g_previewSwitch) return false;
    g_previewSwitch->SetClass("on", g_previewOn.load(std::memory_order_relaxed));

    g_menuDoc->AddEventListener("click", &g_clickListener);

    // Windows: geometry is applied by layoutWindows() right after init; the
    // listeners carry focus, z-order and title-bar dragging. Natural sizes
    // carry the UI scale so the RCSS zoom and the layout math agree.
    kFoldedHeight = kFoldedHeightRef * g_uiScale;
    for (int i = 0; i < kWindowCount; ++i) {
        WinState& win = g_win[i];
        win.el = g_menuDoc->GetElementById(kWindows[i].id);
        win.head = g_menuDoc->GetElementById(kWindows[i].headId);
        if (!win.el || !win.head) return false;
        win.w = kWindows[i].w * g_uiScale;
        win.h = kWindows[i].h * g_uiScale;
        win.shownH = win.h;
        win.el->SetProperty("z-index", Rml::CreateString("%d", 10 + i));
        g_winListeners.push_back(std::make_unique<WindowListener>(&win));
        WindowListener* listener = g_winListeners.back().get();
        win.el->AddEventListener("mousedown", listener);
        win.head->AddEventListener("dragstart", listener);
        win.head->AddEventListener("drag", listener);
    }

    for (const SwitchDef& def : kSwitches) {
        Rml::Element* element = g_menuDoc->GetElementById(def.id);
        if (!element) continue;
        SwitchElem item;
        item.el = element;
        item.def = &def;
        g_switchElems.push_back(item);
    }

    // Every slider is a plain 0..100 percent track (step 1); the mapping to
    // the parameter's spec range lives in domFromParam/paramFromDom. The
    // markup carries the same numbers; this enforces them from the single
    // source of truth so a stale markup range can never fight the mapping.
    for (const SliderDef& def : kSliders) {
        Rml::Element* input = g_menuDoc->GetElementById(def.id);
        if (!input) continue;
        input->SetAttribute("min", 0.0f);
        input->SetAttribute("max", 100.0f);
        input->SetAttribute("step", 1.0f);
    }

    for (const SliderDef& def : kSliders) {
        Rml::Element* input = g_menuDoc->GetElementById(def.id);
        if (!input) continue;
        Rml::Element* readout = g_menuDoc->GetElementById(readoutIdFrom(def.id));
        SliderElem item;
        item.input = input;
        item.readout = readout;
        item.def = &def;
        g_sliderElems.push_back(item);
        g_sliderListeners.push_back(std::make_unique<SliderChangeListener>(&def));
        input->AddEventListener("change", g_sliderListeners.back().get());
    }
    return !g_switchElems.empty() && !g_sliderElems.empty();
}

bool initBackend(ID3D11Device* device, unsigned width, unsigned height) {
    menuLog("init: begin, viewport %ux%u", width, height);
    g_uiScale = computeUiScale(width, height);
    menuLog("init: ui scale %.3f", g_uiScale);
    // Segoe UI covers Cyrillic and is present on every Windows install; the
    // buffers must outlive Rml::Shutdown, so they are file-scope vectors.
    if (!loadFontBuffer("C:/Windows/Fonts/segoeui.ttf", g_fontNormal)) {
        menuLog("init: FAILED, C:/Windows/Fonts/segoeui.ttf unreadable");
        return false;
    }
    if (!loadFontBuffer("C:/Windows/Fonts/segoeuib.ttf", g_fontBold)) {
        menuLog("init: FAILED, C:/Windows/Fonts/segoeuib.ttf unreadable");
        return false;
    }
    menuLog("init: fonts read, %zu + %zu bytes", g_fontNormal.size(), g_fontBold.size());

    g_renderer = new RenderInterface_DX11(device);
    if (!g_renderer) return false;
    Rml::SetRenderInterface(g_renderer);
    // The custom system interface only routes RmlUi log messages into
    // gayclient-menu.log; everything else (elapsed time) stays default.
    Rml::SetSystemInterface(&g_systemInterface);
    // The renderer's internal viewport defaults to zero; without this call
    // BeginFrame would build 0x0 render targets and nothing would show.
    g_renderer->SetViewport(static_cast<int>(width), static_cast<int>(height));
    if (!Rml::Initialise()) {
        menuLog("init: FAILED, Rml::Initialise returned false");
        return false;
    }
    menuLog("init: Rml::Initialise ok");
    g_rmlContext = Rml::CreateContext("gayclient", Rml::Vector2i(static_cast<int>(width),
                                                                 static_cast<int>(height)));
    if (!g_rmlContext) {
        menuLog("init: FAILED, CreateContext returned null");
        return false;
    }
    menuLog("init: context created");

    if (!Rml::LoadFontFace(Rml::Span<const Rml::byte>(
            reinterpret_cast<const Rml::byte*>(g_fontNormal.data()), g_fontNormal.size()),
            "GAY", Rml::Style::FontStyle::Normal, Rml::Style::FontWeight::Auto, true)) {
        menuLog("init: FAILED, LoadFontFace (regular)");
        return false;
    }
    if (!Rml::LoadFontFace(Rml::Span<const Rml::byte>(
            reinterpret_cast<const Rml::byte*>(g_fontBold.data()), g_fontBold.size()),
            "GAY", Rml::Style::FontStyle::Normal, Rml::Style::FontWeight::Bold, true)) {
        menuLog("init: FAILED, LoadFontFace (bold)");
        return false;
    }
    menuLog("init: font faces loaded");

    const std::string scaledRcss = scaleRcssPx(kMenuRcss, g_uiScale);
    g_menuDoc = loadDocumentWithStyle(g_rmlContext, kMenuRml, scaledRcss.c_str(), "gayclient-menu.rml");
    if (!g_menuDoc) {
        menuLog("init: FAILED, menu document did not parse");
        return false;
    }
    menuLog("init: menu document parsed");
    if (!buildRegistry()) {
        menuLog("init: FAILED, element registry incomplete (%zu switches, %zu sliders)",
                g_switchElems.size(), g_sliderElems.size());
        return false;
    }
    // Start faded: the very first Show() then fades the menu in instead of
    // popping.
    if (Rml::Element* body = g_menuDoc->GetElementById("doc-body"))
        body->SetClass("faded", true);
    g_width = width;
    g_height = height;
    menuLog("init: complete, %d windows, %zu switches, %zu sliders",
            kWindowCount, g_switchElems.size(), g_sliderElems.size());
    return true;
}


// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
// Per-frame synchronization and input.
// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

void syncSwitches() {
    syncModuleShadow();
    for (const SwitchElem& item : g_switchElems) {
        if (!item.el || !item.def) continue;
        const bool on = readSwitch(*item.def);
        if (item.el->IsClassSet("on") != on) item.el->SetClass("on", on);
    }
}

void syncSliders() {
    for (SliderElem& item : g_sliderElems) {
        if (!item.input || !item.def) continue;
        const float dom = domFromParam(*item.def, GetVisualParam(item.def->param));
        // Only write when the value actually moved, so the DOM never fights
        // an in-progress drag; writes are stable round-trips by construction.
        const Rml::Variant* current = item.input->GetAttribute("value");
        if (!current || std::fabs(current->Get<float>() - dom) > 0.0005f)
            item.input->SetAttribute("value", dom);
        if (item.readout) {
            char text[32];
            std::snprintf(text, sizeof(text), item.def->fmt, dom);
            if (item.readoutCache != text) {
                item.readoutCache = text;
                item.readout->SetInnerRML(text);
            }
        }
    }
    // Color chips follow the live RGB parameters.
    struct ChipDef { const char* id; VisualParam r, g, b; };
    static const ChipDef kChips[] = {
        {"chip-ch", VisualParam::HatRed, VisualParam::HatGreen, VisualParam::HatBlue},
        {"chip-tr", VisualParam::TrailRed, VisualParam::TrailGreen, VisualParam::TrailBlue},
        {"chip-jr", VisualParam::JumpRed, VisualParam::JumpGreen, VisualParam::JumpBlue},
    };
    for (const ChipDef& chip : kChips) {
        Rml::Element* element = g_menuDoc->GetElementById(chip.id);
        if (!element) continue;
        const int r = static_cast<int>(clamp01(GetVisualParam(chip.r)) * 255.0f + 0.5f);
        const int g = static_cast<int>(clamp01(GetVisualParam(chip.g)) * 255.0f + 0.5f);
        const int b = static_cast<int>(clamp01(GetVisualParam(chip.b)) * 255.0f + 0.5f);
        element->SetProperty("background-color", Rml::CreateString("rgb(%d, %d, %d)", r, g, b));
    }
}

const char* katanaStatusText(int status) {
    switch (status) {
        case 1: return "Katana: рисуется (world pass)";
        case 2: return "Katana: отрисовка недоступна; оставлен оригинал";
        case 9: return "Katana: локальный игрок не найден";
        case 10: return "Katana: меч не сопоставлен";
        case 11: return "Katana: кандидат меча";
        case 12: return "Katana: третья персона ещё не подтверждена";
        case 13: return "Katana: поворот нечитаем; оставлен оригинал";
        case 14: return "Katana: виден; заменяю меч";
        case 15: return "Katana: модель недействительна";
        default: return "Katana: ожидание алмазного меча в руке";
    }
}

void syncTtStatus() {
    if (!g_menuShown || !g_ttStatus || !g_ttDiag) return;
    const std::string status = katanaStatusText(KatanaStatus());
    if (status != g_ttStatusCache) {
        g_ttStatusCache = status;
        g_ttStatus->SetInnerRML(status);
    }
    std::string diag;
    if (KatanaEnabled()) {
        const KatanaDiagnostics d = KatanaDebugSnapshot();
        char line[256];
        std::snprintf(line, sizeof(line),
            "P:%u A:%u B:%u H:%u%s yaw %+.2f pitch %+.2f",
            d.sources & 1 ? 1u : 0u, d.sources & 2 ? 1u : 0u,
            d.sources & 4 ? 1u : 0u, d.sources & 8 ? 1u : 0u,
            d.wrapped ? " (wrap)" : "", d.yaw, d.pitchUp);
        diag = line;
        std::snprintf(line, sizeof(line), "<br/>F:%u V:%u S:%u C:%u R:%u X:%u D:%u O:%u P:%u",
            KatanaEvidence() ? 1u : 0u, !!(KatanaEvidence() & 2), !!(KatanaEvidence() & 16),
            static_cast<unsigned>((!!(KatanaEvidence() & 32)) | (!!(KatanaEvidence() & 64) << 1)),
            !!(KatanaEvidence() & 256), !!(KatanaEvidence() & 512), !!(KatanaEvidence() & 128),
            !!(KatanaEvidence() & 2048),
            static_cast<unsigned>((!!(KatanaEvidence() & 4096)) | (!!(KatanaEvidence() & 8192) << 1)));
        diag += line;
        std::snprintf(line, sizeof(line), "<br/>CI:%llX PL:%llX H58:%llX",
            d.clientInstance, d.player, d.rotationHolder);
        diag += line;
        std::snprintf(line, sizeof(line), "<br/>TP in:%d out:%d tex:%llX learned:%llX",
            d.tpCallsInPass, d.tpCallsOutOfPass, d.tpLastTexture, d.learnedTexture);
        diag += line;
    } else {
        diag = "Katana выключен";
    }
    if (diag != g_ttDiagCache) {
        g_ttDiagCache = diag;
        g_ttDiag->SetInnerRML(diag);
    }
}

void feedInput(unsigned width, unsigned height) {
    if (g_pointerValid.load(std::memory_order_relaxed)) {
        const float w = g_pointerW.load(std::memory_order_relaxed);
        const float h = g_pointerH.load(std::memory_order_relaxed);
        if (w > 1.0f && h > 1.0f) {
            const float mx = g_pointerX.load(std::memory_order_relaxed) *
                (static_cast<float>(width) / w);
            const float my = g_pointerY.load(std::memory_order_relaxed) *
                (static_cast<float>(height) / h);
            g_rmlContext->ProcessMouseMove(static_cast<int>(mx), static_cast<int>(my), 0);
        }
    }
    // RmlUi processes every call as a fresh event, so buttons and keys are
    // forwarded on state transitions only (mirroring the window event model).
    for (int button = 0; button < 2; ++button) {
        const bool down = keyIsDown(button == 0 ? VK_LBUTTON : VK_RBUTTON);
        if (down == g_mouseStates[button]) continue;
        g_mouseStates[button] = down;
        if (down) g_rmlContext->ProcessMouseButtonDown(button, 0);
        else g_rmlContext->ProcessMouseButtonUp(button, 0);
    }
    const float wheelX = g_wheelX.exchange(0.0f, std::memory_order_relaxed);
    const float wheelY = g_wheelY.exchange(0.0f, std::memory_order_relaxed);
    // compat sends one unit per wheel notch (positive = wheel rolled
    // forward/up, the Windows convention); RmlUi expects positive deltas to
    // scroll toward the content bottom, so the sign is flipped here.
    if (wheelX != 0.0f || wheelY != 0.0f)
        g_rmlContext->ProcessMouseWheel(Rml::Vector2f(-wheelX, -wheelY), 0);

    const bool escape = keyIsDown(VK_ESCAPE);
    if (escape != g_escState) {
        g_escState = escape;
        if (escape) g_rmlContext->ProcessKeyDown(Rml::Input::KeyIdentifier::KI_ESCAPE, 0);
        else g_rmlContext->ProcessKeyUp(Rml::Input::KeyIdentifier::KI_ESCAPE, 0);
    }
}

void updateDocVisibility(bool menuVisible) {
    if (menuVisible != g_menuShown) {
        g_menuShown = menuVisible;
        // The fade runs through the body.faded class: class flips start CSS
        // transitions in RmlUi, inline SetProperty does not.
        Rml::Element* body = g_menuDoc->GetElementById("doc-body");
        if (menuVisible) {
            g_fadeOutFrames = 0;
            g_menuDoc->Show();
            if (body) body->SetClass("faded", false);
        } else {
            if (body) body->SetClass("faded", true);
            g_fadeOutFrames = kFadeOutFrames;
        }
    }
    if (!g_menuShown && g_fadeOutFrames > 0) {
        --g_fadeOutFrames;
        if (g_fadeOutFrames == 0) g_menuDoc->Hide();
    }
}

} // namespace

void SetPointer(float clientX, float clientY, float clientWidth, float clientHeight) {
    if (clientWidth <= 0.0f || clientHeight <= 0.0f) return;
    g_pointerX.store(clientX, std::memory_order_relaxed);
    g_pointerY.store(clientY, std::memory_order_relaxed);
    g_pointerW.store(clientWidth, std::memory_order_relaxed);
    g_pointerH.store(clientHeight, std::memory_order_relaxed);
    g_pointerValid.store(true, std::memory_order_relaxed);
}

void AddWheel(float dx, float dy) {
    if (dx == 0.0f && dy == 0.0f) return;
    g_wheelX.store(dx, std::memory_order_relaxed);
    g_wheelY.store(dy, std::memory_order_relaxed);
}

void SetKeyQuery(bool (*query)(int)) { g_keyDown = query; }
void SetModuleStateReader(bool (*reader)(int)) { g_moduleStateReader = reader; }

void DrainModuleToggles(void (*toggler)(int, bool)) {
    if (!toggler) return;
    std::vector<std::pair<int, bool>> pending;
    {
        std::lock_guard<std::mutex> lock(g_pendingMutex);
        if (g_pendingToggles.empty()) return;
        pending.swap(g_pendingToggles);
    }
    for (const auto& toggle : pending) toggler(toggle.first, toggle.second);
}

void SetGameMenuOpen(bool open) {
    if (!open) g_hiddenByClose.store(false, std::memory_order_relaxed);
    g_gameMenuOpen.store(open, std::memory_order_relaxed);
}

bool ReplacesLegacyMenu() { return g_renderOk.load(std::memory_order_relaxed); }
bool ConsumeHudEditorRequest() { return g_hudEditorRequest.exchange(false, std::memory_order_relaxed); }
bool VisualPreviewActive() { return g_previewOn.load(std::memory_order_relaxed); }
// True when the user closed the menu with the X button (or entered the HUD
// editor) while the client still considers its menu open. The compat layer
// uses this to clear the client's menu flag, otherwise the game stays in
// menu mode with input suppressed and its own screens misbehave.
bool IsHiddenByClose() { return g_hiddenByClose.load(std::memory_order_relaxed); }

bool ReadPointer(float& x, float& y, float& w, float& h) {
    if (!g_pointerValid.load(std::memory_order_relaxed)) return false;
    x = g_pointerX.load(std::memory_order_relaxed);
    y = g_pointerY.load(std::memory_order_relaxed);
    w = g_pointerW.load(std::memory_order_relaxed);
    h = g_pointerH.load(std::memory_order_relaxed);
    return w > 1.0f && h > 1.0f;
}

void RenderOverlay(ID3D11Device* device, ID3D11RenderTargetView* rtv,
                   unsigned width, unsigned height) {
    if (g_initFailed || !device || !rtv || width < 200 || height < 200) return;
    if (!g_ready) {
        if (!initBackend(device, width, height)) {
            g_initFailed = true;
            return;
        }
        g_ready = true;
        layoutWindows(static_cast<float>(width), static_cast<float>(height), true);
    }
    if (width != g_width || height != g_height) {
        g_width = width;
        g_height = height;
        g_rmlContext->SetDimensions(Rml::Vector2i(static_cast<int>(width),
                                                  static_cast<int>(height)));
        g_renderer->SetViewport(static_cast<int>(width), static_cast<int>(height));
        layoutWindows(static_cast<float>(width), static_cast<float>(height), false);
    }

    const bool menuVisible = g_gameMenuOpen.load(std::memory_order_relaxed) &&
        !g_hiddenByClose.load(std::memory_order_relaxed);
    updateDocVisibility(menuVisible);
    // A few frames after closing, the document still renders so the fade-out
    // transition is seen, but input is cut immediately.
    if (!menuVisible && g_fadeOutFrames == 0) return;

    if (menuVisible) {
        feedInput(width, height);
        syncSwitches();
        syncSliders();
        syncTtStatus();
    }
    stepWindowAnims();
    g_rmlContext->Update();
    g_renderer->BeginFrame();
    g_rmlContext->Render();
    // EndFrame binds the back-buffer render target view, resolves the frame
    // and restores the DirectX state it changed, so the game's own Present
    // path is untouched.
    g_renderer->EndFrame(rtv);
    if (!g_renderOk.exchange(true, std::memory_order_relaxed))
        menuLog("render: first frame complete, new menu is now live");
}

} // namespace menu_rml

// v6: two windows (Home + Visuals). Switches are square checkboxes (empty
// square when off, check mark when on). No decorative icon chips: module rows
// are clean text rows. Sections animate open/closed through a max-height
// transition, the document fades in/out, and windows fold through a short
// C++ height interpolation. Typography is plain ASCII: hyphens only, no
// middle-dot separators (they read as generated text).
// Kept as raw strings so the DLL stays a single file with no disk access.

#pragma once
#include <cstdint>

// No WinRT calls or pointers. The game handler's +0x72 is its reported grab
// state; +0x74 is its pending command (0 none, 1 grab, 2 release) in the
// exact executable. Async transitions can finish after the menu closes.
namespace menu_mouse {
struct CursorPolicy {
 bool open=false, restore=false, releasePending=false, closing=false;
 std::uint64_t closingSince=0;
 struct Decision { std::uint32_t command; bool entering; };
 Decision step(bool menu, bool grabbed, std::uint32_t command, std::uint64_t now) {
  const bool entering=menu && !open;
  if (entering) {
   open=true; closing=false; releasePending=false;
   restore=command==2 ? false : (grabbed || command==1);
  }
  if (menu) {
   if (!entering && command==1) restore=true;
   if (!entering && command==2) restore=false;
   // Do not allow a grab during the menu. A release request only needs to be
   // scheduled once: the game's release method clears its command and posts
   // an asynchronous callback that later changes the reported grab state.
   if (command==1) command=0;
   if (!grabbed) { releasePending=false; if (command==2) command=0; }
   else if (!releasePending) { command=2; releasePending=true; }
   return {command,entering};
  }
  if (open) { open=false; closing=restore; closingSince=now; }
  if (closing) {
   if (command==2 || now<closingSince || now-closingSince>5000) {
    closing=false;
   } else if (!grabbed) {
    // The release callback completed; restore the state that preceded us.
    command=1; closing=false; releasePending=false;
   } else if (!releasePending) closing=false;
  }
  return {command,false};
 }
};
// Only buttons previously forwarded to the game may have their up edge
// forwarded while the menu is open. New button presses, movement and wheel
// are discarded. A caller can instead synthesize all outstanding up edges.
inline unsigned buttonBit(unsigned action) { return action>=1 && action<=3 ? 1u<<(action-1) : 0u; }
inline bool allowMouse(bool menu, unsigned action, bool pressed, unsigned oldHeld) {
 return !menu || (!pressed && (oldHeld & buttonBit(action)) != 0);
}
}

#include "../src/menu_mouse_policy.h"
#include <cassert>
#include <cstdint>
using namespace menu_mouse;
int main() {
 CursorPolicy p;
 auto d=p.step(false,true,0,0); assert(!d.entering && d.command==0);
 d=p.step(true,true,0,10); assert(d.entering && d.command==2 && p.restore && p.releasePending);
 d=p.step(true,true,0,20); assert(!d.entering && d.command==0); // no repeated async releases
 d=p.step(true,false,0,30); assert(d.command==0 && !p.releasePending);
 d=p.step(false,false,0,40); assert(d.command==1 && !p.closing);
 d=p.step(false,true,0,50); assert(d.command==0);
 // Menu opened over an already released game UI: do not grab on close.
 CursorPolicy ui; assert(ui.step(true,false,0,0).command==0);
 assert(ui.step(false,false,0,1).command==0);
 // Closing before the async release callback must wait for its completion.
 CursorPolicy async; assert(async.step(true,true,0,10).command==2);
 assert(async.step(false,true,0,20).command==0 && async.closing);
 assert(async.step(false,false,0,30).command==1 && !async.closing);
 // Game's own release while menu is active cancels our restoration.
 CursorPolicy game; assert(game.step(true,true,0,1).command==2);
 assert(game.step(true,false,0,2).command==0);
 assert(game.step(true,false,2,3).command==0 && !game.restore);
 assert(game.step(false,false,0,4).command==0);
 // Game requests a grab while menu is open: defer until menu closes.
 CursorPolicy regrab; assert(regrab.step(true,false,0,1).command==0);
 assert(regrab.step(true,false,1,2).command==0 && regrab.restore);
 assert(regrab.step(false,false,0,3).command==1);
 // No event added by the menu can create a new game press or move/wheel.
 for(unsigned action=0;action<5;++action) {
  assert(!allowMouse(true,action,true,7));
  assert(allowMouse(false,action,true,0));
 }
 assert(!allowMouse(true,0,false,7)); assert(!allowMouse(true,4,false,7));
 assert(allowMouse(true,1,false,1)); assert(!allowMouse(true,1,false,0));
 assert(buttonBit(1)==1 && buttonBit(2)==2 && buttonBit(3)==4 && !buttonBit(4));
 // Failed async callback: no permanently pending restore.
 CursorPolicy timeout; timeout.step(true,true,0,1); timeout.step(false,true,0,2);
 timeout.step(false,true,0,5003); assert(!timeout.closing);
}

// Additional UWP input collected on the same dispatcher thread as the legacy
// CoreWindow bridge. Interface order follows Windows SDK / windows-rs metadata.
#include "uwp_extra.h"
#include "pointer_mapping.h"
#define WIN32_LEAN_AND_MEAN
#define NOMINMAX
#include <windows.h>
#include <roapi.h>
#include <winstring.h>
#include <inspectable.h>
#include <atomic>
#include <new>

struct UwpPoint { float x, y; };
struct UwpRect { float x, y, w, h; };
struct CoreWindow : IInspectable {
    virtual HRESULT STDMETHODCALLTYPE unusedAutomation() = 0;
    virtual HRESULT STDMETHODCALLTYPE get_Bounds(UwpRect*) = 0;
    virtual HRESULT STDMETHODCALLTYPE unusedProperties() = 0;
    virtual HRESULT STDMETHODCALLTYPE unusedDispatcher() = 0;
    virtual HRESULT STDMETHODCALLTYPE unusedFlow() = 0;
    virtual HRESULT STDMETHODCALLTYPE unusedSetFlow() = 0;
    virtual HRESULT STDMETHODCALLTYPE unusedInput() = 0;
    virtual HRESULT STDMETHODCALLTYPE unusedSetInput() = 0;
    virtual HRESULT STDMETHODCALLTYPE unusedCursor() = 0;
    virtual HRESULT STDMETHODCALLTYPE unusedSetCursor() = 0;
    virtual HRESULT STDMETHODCALLTYPE get_PointerPosition(UwpPoint*) = 0;
    virtual HRESULT STDMETHODCALLTYPE unusedVisible() = 0;
    virtual HRESULT STDMETHODCALLTYPE unusedActivate() = 0;
    virtual HRESULT STDMETHODCALLTYPE unusedClose() = 0;
    virtual HRESULT STDMETHODCALLTYPE unusedAsyncKey() = 0;
    virtual HRESULT STDMETHODCALLTYPE unusedKey() = 0;
    virtual HRESULT STDMETHODCALLTYPE unusedReleaseCapture() = 0;
    virtual HRESULT STDMETHODCALLTYPE unusedSetCapture() = 0;
#define UNUSED_PAIR(n) virtual HRESULT STDMETHODCALLTYPE unused##n() = 0; virtual HRESULT STDMETHODCALLTYPE unusedRemove##n() = 0;
    UNUSED_PAIR(Activated) UNUSED_PAIR(AutomationEvent) UNUSED_PAIR(Character) UNUSED_PAIR(Closed)
    UNUSED_PAIR(InputEnabled) UNUSED_PAIR(KeyDown) UNUSED_PAIR(KeyUp) UNUSED_PAIR(CaptureLost)
    UNUSED_PAIR(PointerEntered) UNUSED_PAIR(PointerExited) UNUSED_PAIR(PointerMoved)
    UNUSED_PAIR(PointerPressed) UNUSED_PAIR(PointerReleased) UNUSED_PAIR(TouchHitTesting)
#undef UNUSED_PAIR
    virtual HRESULT STDMETHODCALLTYPE add_PointerWheelChanged(IUnknown*, INT64*) = 0;
};
struct CoreWindowStatics : IInspectable {
    virtual HRESULT STDMETHODCALLTYPE GetForCurrentThread(CoreWindow**) = 0;
};
struct PointerArgs : IInspectable {
    virtual HRESULT STDMETHODCALLTYPE get_CurrentPoint(IInspectable**) = 0;
};
struct PointerPoint : IInspectable {
    virtual HRESULT STDMETHODCALLTYPE unusedDevice() = 0;
    virtual HRESULT STDMETHODCALLTYPE get_Position(UwpPoint*) = 0;
    virtual HRESULT STDMETHODCALLTYPE unusedRawPosition() = 0;
    virtual HRESULT STDMETHODCALLTYPE unusedId() = 0;
    virtual HRESULT STDMETHODCALLTYPE unusedFrame() = 0;
    virtual HRESULT STDMETHODCALLTYPE unusedTimestamp() = 0;
    virtual HRESULT STDMETHODCALLTYPE unusedContact() = 0;
    virtual HRESULT STDMETHODCALLTYPE get_Properties(IInspectable**) = 0;
};
struct PointerProperties : IInspectable {
#define UNUSED(n) virtual HRESULT STDMETHODCALLTYPE unused##n() = 0;
    UNUSED(0) UNUSED(1) UNUSED(2) UNUSED(3) UNUSED(4) UNUSED(5) UNUSED(6)
    UNUSED(7) UNUSED(8) UNUSED(9) UNUSED(10) UNUSED(11) UNUSED(12)
#undef UNUSED
    virtual HRESULT STDMETHODCALLTYPE get_MouseWheelDelta(INT32*) = 0;
    virtual HRESULT STDMETHODCALLTYPE get_IsHorizontalMouseWheel(boolean*) = 0;
};
struct PointerHandler : IUnknown {
    virtual HRESULT STDMETHODCALLTYPE Invoke(IInspectable*, IInspectable*) = 0;
};

namespace {
constexpr GUID iidStatics = {0x4d239005,0x3c2a,0x41b1,{0x90,0x22,0x53,0x6b,0xb9,0xcf,0x93,0xb1}};
constexpr GUID iidArgs = {0x920d9cb1,0xa5fc,0x4a21,{0x8c,0x09,0x49,0xdf,0xe6,0xff,0xe2,0x5f}};
constexpr GUID iidPoint = {0xe995317d,0x7296,0x42d9,{0x82,0x33,0xc5,0xbe,0x73,0xb7,0x4a,0x4a}};
constexpr GUID iidProperties = {0xc79d8a4b,0xc163,0x4ee7,{0x80,0x3f,0x67,0xce,0x79,0xf9,0x97,0x2d}};
constexpr GUID iidHandler = {0x420e1bb6,0xe99d,0x5e64,{0x8e,0x25,0x07,0x46,0x7e,0x3c,0xae,0x9e}};
SRWLOCK sampleLock = SRWLOCK_INIT;
UwpPoint pointer{};
UwpRect bounds{};
bool haveSample = false;
std::atomic<int> wheelX{0}, wheelY{0};
std::atomic<bool> inputEnabled{true};
bool attached = false;
ULONGLONG nextAttempt = 0;

template<class T> void release(T*& p) { if (p) { p->Release(); p = nullptr; } }
class WheelHandler final : public PointerHandler {
    std::atomic<ULONG> refs{1};
public:
    HRESULT STDMETHODCALLTYPE QueryInterface(REFIID iid, void** out) override {
        if (!out) return E_POINTER;
        *out = nullptr;
        if (iid == IID_IUnknown || iid == IID_IAgileObject || iid == iidHandler) {
            *out = static_cast<PointerHandler*>(this); AddRef(); return S_OK;
        }
        return E_NOINTERFACE;
    }
    ULONG STDMETHODCALLTYPE AddRef() override { return ++refs; }
    ULONG STDMETHODCALLTYPE Release() override { ULONG count = --refs; if (!count) delete this; return count; }
    HRESULT STDMETHODCALLTYPE Invoke(IInspectable*, IInspectable* arg) override {
        if (!arg || !inputEnabled.load(std::memory_order_acquire)) return S_OK;
        PointerArgs* args = nullptr; IInspectable* rawPoint = nullptr; PointerPoint* point = nullptr;
        IInspectable* rawProperties = nullptr; PointerProperties* properties = nullptr;
        HRESULT hr = arg->QueryInterface(iidArgs, reinterpret_cast<void**>(&args));
        if (SUCCEEDED(hr) && args) hr = args->get_CurrentPoint(&rawPoint);
        if (SUCCEEDED(hr) && rawPoint) hr = rawPoint->QueryInterface(iidPoint, reinterpret_cast<void**>(&point));
        if (SUCCEEDED(hr) && point) hr = point->get_Properties(&rawProperties);
        if (SUCCEEDED(hr) && rawProperties) hr = rawProperties->QueryInterface(iidProperties, reinterpret_cast<void**>(&properties));
        if (SUCCEEDED(hr) && properties) {
            INT32 delta = 0; boolean horizontal = 0;
            if (SUCCEEDED(properties->get_MouseWheelDelta(&delta)) &&
                SUCCEEDED(properties->get_IsHorizontalMouseWheel(&horizontal))) {
                if (delta > 12000) delta = 12000;
                if (delta < -12000) delta = -12000;
                (horizontal ? wheelX : wheelY).fetch_add(delta, std::memory_order_relaxed);
            }
        }
        release(properties); release(rawProperties); release(point); release(rawPoint); release(args);
        return S_OK;
    }
};
}

void SampleUwpInput() {
    if (!inputEnabled.load(std::memory_order_acquire)) return;
    HSTRING className = nullptr;
    CoreWindowStatics* statics = nullptr;
    CoreWindow* window = nullptr;
    constexpr wchar_t name[] = L"Windows.UI.Core.CoreWindow";
    HRESULT hr = WindowsCreateString(name, static_cast<UINT32>(sizeof(name)/sizeof(name[0])-1), &className);
    if (SUCCEEDED(hr)) hr = RoGetActivationFactory(className, iidStatics, reinterpret_cast<void**>(&statics));
    if (SUCCEEDED(hr) && statics) hr = statics->GetForCurrentThread(&window);
    if (SUCCEEDED(hr) && window) {
        UwpPoint p{}; UwpRect r{};
        if (SUCCEEDED(window->get_PointerPosition(&p)) && SUCCEEDED(window->get_Bounds(&r)) && r.w > 0 && r.h > 0) {
            AcquireSRWLockExclusive(&sampleLock);
            pointer = p; bounds = r; haveSample = true;
            ReleaseSRWLockExclusive(&sampleLock);
        }
        ULONGLONG now = GetTickCount64();
        if (!attached && now >= nextAttempt) {
            nextAttempt = now + 2000;
            WheelHandler* handler = new (std::nothrow) WheelHandler;
            if (handler) {
                INT64 token = 0;
                attached = SUCCEEDED(window->add_PointerWheelChanged(handler, &token));
                handler->Release();
                if (attached) OutputDebugStringA("GAYClient repair: UWP mouse wheel handler attached\n");
            }
        }
    }
    release(window); release(statics);
    if (className) WindowsDeleteString(className);
}
bool GetSampledUwpPointer(float& x, float& y, float& w, float& h) {
    AcquireSRWLockShared(&sampleLock);
    bool valid = haveSample && uwp_client_pointer(pointer.x, pointer.y, bounds.x, bounds.y,
                                                   bounds.w, bounds.h, x, y, w, h);
    ReleaseSRWLockShared(&sampleLock);
    return valid;
}
void DisableUwpExtraInput() {
    inputEnabled.store(false, std::memory_order_release);
    wheelX.store(0, std::memory_order_relaxed); wheelY.store(0, std::memory_order_relaxed);
}
void TakeUwpWheel(int& horizontal, int& vertical) {
    horizontal = wheelX.exchange(0, std::memory_order_relaxed);
    vertical = wheelY.exchange(0, std::memory_order_relaxed);
}

#pragma once
#include <cstdint>

// Simple key-repeat fallback when UWP doesn't deliver mouse-wheel events.
// Returns an ImGui vertical wheel value, never queues scroll with no menu.
struct PageScrollRepeat {
    int direction = 0;
    std::uint64_t next = 0;
    float step(bool enabled, bool pageUp, bool pageDown, std::uint64_t nowMs) {
        const int requested = enabled ? (pageUp ? 1 : 0) - (pageDown ? 1 : 0) : 0;
        if (!requested) { direction = 0; next = 0; return 0.0f; }
        if (requested != direction) {
            direction = requested; next = nowMs + 400;
            return static_cast<float>(requested);
        }
        if (nowMs >= next) {
            next = nowMs + 110;
            return static_cast<float>(requested);
        }
        return 0.0f;
    }
};

#pragma once

#define NOMINMAX

// Pagefile-backed mapping shared by duplicating a read-only handle into the
// game. Never a named object, never a disk file. Aligned 32-bit counter reads
// are atomic on the x64 Windows targets supported by this project.
struct WheelBridge {
    std::uint32_t magic;
    std::uint32_t version;
    volatile LONG horizontal;
    volatile LONG vertical;
};
constexpr std::uint32_t kWheelMagic = 0x47574831;
static_assert(sizeof(WheelBridge) == 16, "wheel bridge ABI");

#pragma once
#include <cstdint>
#include <cstring>

// Windows wheel deltas can accumulate through 32-bit signed wraparound.
// Read the cumulative value without modifying the read-only mapping.
struct WheelCounter {
    std::uint32_t lastX = 0, lastY = 0;
    bool initialized = false;
    static int delta(std::uint32_t current, std::uint32_t last) {
        std::uint32_t modular = current - last;
        std::int32_t value = 0;
        std::memcpy(&value, &modular, sizeof(value));
        return value > 12000 ? 12000 : value < -12000 ? -12000 : value;
    }
    void reset() { initialized = false; }
    void take(std::uint32_t currentX, std::uint32_t currentY, int& x, int& y) {
        if (!initialized) { lastX = currentX; lastY = currentY; initialized = true; }
        x = delta(currentX, lastX); y = delta(currentY, lastY);
        lastX = currentX; lastY = currentY;
    }
};

#pragma once
#include <cstdint>
#include <cstddef>
#include <cmath>
#include <limits>

struct Position115 { float x, y, z; };
struct BlockPosition115 { int x, y, z; };

// The reader validates ranges and finiteness before this is called. Block
// coordinates floor toward negative infinity, not toward zero. The one-block
// vertical correction is a display calibration based on player feedback; it
// does not change the raw values used for the independent Y consistency test.
inline BlockPosition115 displayPosition115(const Position115& position) {
    return {static_cast<int>(std::floor(position.x)),
            static_cast<int>(std::floor(position.y)) - 1,
            static_cast<int>(std::floor(position.z))};
}

// Experimental, read-only 1.1.5 paths. A separate height path is required
// for either candidate. No failed read may replace out or reuse old values.
template<class Read> bool readPosition115(std::uint64_t base, Read read, Position115& out) {
    auto pointer = [&](std::uint64_t address, std::uint64_t& value) {
        return address && read(address, &value, sizeof(value)) && value >= 0x10000 &&
               value < 0x0000800000000000ULL && (value & 7) == 0;
    };
    auto add = [](std::uint64_t a, std::uint64_t b, std::uint64_t& value) {
        if (a > std::numeric_limits<std::uint64_t>::max() - b) return false;
        value = a + b; return true;
    };
    auto chain = [&](std::uint64_t start, const std::uint64_t* offsets, std::size_t count, std::uint64_t& result) {
        std::uint64_t address = 0;
        if (!pointer(start, result)) return false;
        for (std::size_t i = 0; i < count; ++i)
            if (!add(result, offsets[i], address) || !pointer(address, result)) return false;
        return true;
    };
    constexpr std::uint64_t yPath[] = {0x30, 0x328, 0x0, 0x68, 0x90, 0x18};
    constexpr std::uint64_t playerPath[] = {0x30, 0x2c0, 0x0, 0x78, 0x28, 0x58};
    std::uint64_t sharedStart = 0, yRoot = 0, address = 0;
    if (!add(base, 0x01921DF8, sharedStart) ||
        !chain(sharedStart, yPath, sizeof(yPath)/sizeof(yPath[0]), yRoot)) return false;
    float separateY = 0;
    if (!add(yRoot, 0x164, address) || !read(address, &separateY, sizeof(separateY)) ||
        !std::isfinite(separateY) || std::fabs(separateY) > 4096.0f) return false;
    auto plausible = [&](const Position115& p) {
        return std::isfinite(p.x) && std::isfinite(p.y) && std::isfinite(p.z) &&
               std::fabs(p.x) <= 30000000.0f && std::fabs(p.z) <= 30000000.0f &&
               std::fabs(p.y) <= 4096.0f && std::fabs(p.y - separateY) <= 2.5f;
    };
    auto yStillValid = [&]() {
        std::uint64_t again = 0;
        return chain(sharedStart, yPath, sizeof(yPath)/sizeof(yPath[0]), again) && again == yRoot;
    };
    // C: alternative local player chain observed by the user's diagnostic.
    std::uint64_t player = 0, again = 0;
    Position115 candidate{};
    if (chain(sharedStart, playerPath, sizeof(playerPath)/sizeof(playerPath[0]), player) &&
        add(player, 0x94, address) && read(address, &candidate, sizeof(candidate)) && plausible(candidate) &&
        chain(sharedStart, playerPath, sizeof(playerPath)/sizeof(playerPath[0]), again) && again == player &&
        yStillValid()) {
        out = candidate;
        return true;
    }
    // A: retain the earlier candidate as a fallback for other matching builds.
    std::uint64_t rootAddress = 0, root = 0;
    if (!add(base, 0x019431E0, rootAddress) || !pointer(rootAddress, root) ||
        !add(root, 0x524, address) || !read(address, &candidate, sizeof(candidate)) || !plausible(candidate) ||
        !pointer(rootAddress, again) || again != root || !yStillValid()) return false;
    out = candidate;
    return true;
}

#pragma once
#include <cstddef>
#include <cstdint>
#include <cstring>

// Exact legacy core only. The JNE at 0x183d branches into the mouse test
// background and text. Six NOPs fall through to ImGui::Render at 0x1843.
// The checks deliberately fail closed for a different core or existing patch.
namespace mouse_diagnostic_patch {
constexpr std::size_t codeRva = 0x1836;
constexpr std::size_t branchRva = 0x183d;
constexpr std::size_t formatRva = 0x1bb008;
constexpr unsigned char code[] = {0xe8,0xf5,0x17,0x00,0x00,0x84,0xc0,0x0f,0x85,0x18,0x02,0x00,0x00,0xe8,0xb8,0x67,0x05,0x00};
constexpr char format[] = "UWP mouse test: reg %u/3  events %u  poll %u/3 %s";
inline bool matches(const unsigned char* image, std::size_t size) {
    return image && size >= formatRva + sizeof(format) && size >= codeRva + sizeof(code) &&
        std::memcmp(image + codeRva, code, sizeof(code)) == 0 &&
        std::memcmp(image + formatRva, format, sizeof(format)) == 0;
}
inline void apply(unsigned char* image) { std::memset(image + branchRva, 0x90, 6); }
}

#pragma once
// Disable only on a fresh Delete press, in the active game, never while an
// ImGui text editor is accepting input. Ignore holds and background presses.
class DisableHotkey {
    bool wasDown = false;
public:
    bool update(bool down, bool gameForeground, bool editingText) {
        bool pressed = down && !wasDown && gameForeground && !editingText;
        wasDown = down;
        return pressed;
    }
};

#define VISUAL_GPU_DEPTH_TEST_TYPES "../tests/visual_gpu_mock_types.h"
#include "../src/visual_gpu_depth.h"
#include <cassert>
#include <cmath>
struct View:ID3D11DepthStencilView { unsigned refs=1; ULONG AddRef() override{return ++refs;} ULONG Release() override{return --refs;} };
struct Depth:ID3D11DepthStencilState {
 unsigned refs=1; D3D11_DEPTH_STENCIL_DESC desc{}; bool owned=false;
 void GetDesc(D3D11_DEPTH_STENCIL_DESC* d) override {*d=desc;} ULONG AddRef() override{return ++refs;}
 ULONG Release() override {auto n=--refs; if (!n && owned) delete this; return n;}
};
struct Blend:ID3D11BlendState {
 unsigned refs=1; D3D11_BLEND_DESC desc{}; bool owned=false;
 void GetDesc(D3D11_BLEND_DESC* d) override {*d=desc;} ULONG AddRef() override{return ++refs;}
 ULONG Release() override {auto n=--refs; if (!n && owned) delete this; return n;}
};
struct Device:ID3D11Device {
 bool failDepth=false, failBlend=false;
 HRESULT CreateDepthStencilState(const D3D11_DEPTH_STENCIL_DESC* d,ID3D11DepthStencilState** out) override {
  if (failDepth) return E_FAIL;
  auto* p=new Depth; p->desc=*d; p->owned=true; *out=p; return 0;
 }
 HRESULT CreateBlendState(const D3D11_BLEND_DESC* d,ID3D11BlendState** out) override {
  if (failBlend) return E_FAIL;
  auto* p=new Blend; p->desc=*d; p->owned=true; *out=p; return 0;
 }
 ULONG Release() override{return 1;}
};
struct Context:ID3D11DeviceContext {
 View view, other; Depth depth; Blend blend; Device device;
 ID3D11DepthStencilView* dsv=&view; ID3D11DepthStencilState* curDepth=&depth; ID3D11BlendState* curBlend=&blend;
 UINT stencil=7,mask=0xfffffffe; FLOAT factor[4]{.2f,.3f,.4f,.5f}; int sets=0; bool hasDevice=true;
 void OMGetRenderTargets(UINT,void*,ID3D11DepthStencilView** o) override {*o=dsv;if(*o)(*o)->AddRef();}
 void OMGetDepthStencilState(ID3D11DepthStencilState** o,UINT* r) override {*o=curDepth;if(*o)(*o)->AddRef();*r=stencil;}
 void OMGetBlendState(ID3D11BlendState** o,FLOAT* f,UINT* m) override {*o=curBlend;if(*o)(*o)->AddRef();for(int i=0;i<4;i++)f[i]=factor[i];*m=mask;}
 void GetDevice(ID3D11Device** o) override {*o=hasDevice?&device:nullptr;}
 void OMSetDepthStencilState(ID3D11DepthStencilState* p,UINT r) override {curDepth=p;stencil=r;sets++;}
 void OMSetBlendState(ID3D11BlendState* p,const FLOAT* f,UINT m) override {curBlend=p;mask=m;for(int i=0;i<4;i++)factor[i]=f[i];sets++;}
};
static int observed=0, replayStarts=0,replayEnds=0; static bool replayAllowed=true;
static bool beginReplay(ID3D11DeviceContext*) { ++replayStarts; return replayAllowed; }
static void endReplay(ID3D11DeviceContext*) { ++replayEnds; }
static void observePlayer(ID3D11DeviceContext*) { ++observed; }
int main() {
 using namespace visual_gpu_depth;
 Context ctx; int calls=0; inVisualDraw=false; playerObserver.store(&observePlayer);
 draw(&ctx,[&]{++calls;}); assert(calls==1 && ctx.sets==0 && observed==0);
 katanaSuppress=&ctx; draw(&ctx,[&]{++calls;}); assert(calls==1);
 Context otherContext; draw(&otherContext,[&]{++calls;}); assert(calls==2); katanaSuppress=nullptr; calls=1;
 inPlayerCapture=true; draw(&ctx,[&]{++calls;}); assert(calls==2 && ctx.sets==0 && observed==1);
 // World is drawn first; only allowed draw types are replayed and state is
 // restored even if a simulated replay throws.
 replayBegin.store(&beginReplay); replayEnd.store(&endReplay);
 int startCalls=calls; int pass=0;
 draw(&ctx,[&]{++calls; ++pass; assert(inPlayerCapture==(pass==1));},true);
 assert(calls==startCalls+2 && replayStarts==1 && replayEnds==1 && inPlayerCapture);
 startCalls=calls; draw(&ctx,[&]{++calls;},false); assert(calls==startCalls+1 && replayStarts==1 && replayEnds==1);
 replayAllowed=false; startCalls=calls; draw(&ctx,[&]{++calls;},true); assert(calls==startCalls+1 && replayStarts==2 && replayEnds==1);
 replayAllowed=true; int step=0; try { draw(&ctx,[&]{if(++step==2) throw 5;},true); assert(false); } catch(int e) {assert(e==5);}
 assert(step==2 && replayStarts==3 && replayEnds==2);
 inPlayerCapture=false; startCalls=calls; draw(&ctx,[&]{++calls;},true); assert(calls==startCalls+1 && replayStarts==3);
 replayBegin.store(nullptr); replayEnd.store(nullptr); playerObserver.store(nullptr); calls=1;
 expectedContext=&ctx; expectedDepth=&ctx.view; worldCompare=D3D11_COMPARISON_LESS_EQUAL; opacity=.25f; inVisualDraw=true;
 draw(&ctx,[&]{
  ++calls; D3D11_DEPTH_STENCIL_DESC d{}; ctx.curDepth->GetDesc(&d);
  assert(d.DepthEnable && d.DepthWriteMask==D3D11_DEPTH_WRITE_MASK_ZERO && d.DepthFunc==D3D11_COMPARISON_LESS_EQUAL && !d.StencilEnable);
  D3D11_BLEND_DESC b{}; ctx.curBlend->GetDesc(&b); assert(b.RenderTarget[0].BlendEnable && b.RenderTarget[0].SrcBlend==D3D11_BLEND_BLEND_FACTOR);
  assert(std::fabs(ctx.factor[0]-.25f)<.00001f);
 });
 assert(calls==2 && ctx.curDepth==&ctx.depth && ctx.curBlend==&ctx.blend && ctx.stencil==7 && ctx.mask==0xfffffffe);
 assert(ctx.factor[0]==.2f && ctx.factor[3]==.5f && ctx.depth.refs==1 && ctx.blend.refs==1 && ctx.view.refs==1);
 // Only a submitted hat is copied, with the world's guarded opacity/depth
 // still active; failures skip the copy but never suppress the world draw.
 replayBegin.store(&beginReplay); replayEnd.store(&endReplay); inHatCapture=true;
 int copyPass=0, oldStarts=replayStarts, oldEnds=replayEnds;
 draw(&ctx,[&]{++copyPass; assert(ctx.curDepth!=&ctx.depth && ctx.curBlend!=&ctx.blend);},true);
 assert(copyPass==2 && replayStarts==oldStarts+1 && replayEnds==oldEnds+1 && inHatCapture);
 assert(ctx.curDepth==&ctx.depth && ctx.curBlend==&ctx.blend);
 replayAllowed=false; copyPass=0;
 draw(&ctx,[&]{++copyPass;},true); assert(copyPass==1 && replayEnds==oldEnds+1);
 replayAllowed=true; copyPass=0;
 try {draw(&ctx,[&]{if(++copyPass==2) throw 7;},true); assert(false);} catch(int e) {assert(e==7);}
 assert(copyPass==2 && replayEnds==oldEnds+2 && inHatCapture && ctx.curDepth==&ctx.depth && ctx.curBlend==&ctx.blend);
 inHatCapture=false; replayBegin.store(nullptr); replayEnd.store(nullptr);
 int before=ctx.sets; ctx.dsv=&ctx.other; draw(&ctx,[&]{++calls;}); assert(calls==2 && ctx.sets==before && ctx.other.refs==1);
 ctx.dsv=&ctx.view; ctx.device.failBlend=true; draw(&ctx,[&]{++calls;}); assert(calls==2 && ctx.sets==before);
 assert(ctx.curDepth==&ctx.depth && ctx.curBlend==&ctx.blend && ctx.depth.refs==1 && ctx.blend.refs==1 && ctx.view.refs==1);
 ctx.device.failBlend=false; ctx.device.failDepth=true; draw(&ctx,[&]{++calls;}); assert(calls==2 && ctx.sets==before);
 ctx.device.failDepth=false; ctx.curDepth=nullptr; ctx.curBlend=nullptr;
 draw(&ctx,[&]{
  ++calls; D3D11_DEPTH_STENCIL_DESC d{}; ctx.curDepth->GetDesc(&d);
  assert(d.FrontFace.StencilFunc==D3D11_COMPARISON_ALWAYS && d.BackFace.StencilFunc==D3D11_COMPARISON_ALWAYS);
  D3D11_BLEND_DESC b{}; ctx.curBlend->GetDesc(&b);
  assert(b.RenderTarget[0].BlendEnable && b.RenderTarget[1].BlendOp==D3D11_BLEND_OP_ADD);
 });
 assert(calls==3 && !ctx.curDepth && !ctx.curBlend && ctx.view.refs==1);
 Context wrong; draw(&wrong,[&]{++calls;}); assert(calls==3 && wrong.sets==0);
 ctx.hasDevice=false; int sets=ctx.sets; draw(&ctx,[&]{++calls;}); assert(calls==3 && ctx.sets==sets);
 inVisualDraw=false; expectedContext=nullptr; expectedDepth=nullptr;
 // Check all seven expected D3D slots and reject ambiguous aliases before
 // creating any hooks. No fake COM method is invoked in this test.
 void* table[41]{};
 for (std::size_t i=0;i<7;++i) table[drawSlots[i]]=reinterpret_cast<void*>(static_cast<std::uintptr_t>(100+i));
 struct FakeObject { void** vtable; } fake{table};
 int created=0,enabled=0;

 auto enable=[&](void*) {++enabled; return 0;};
 auto disable=[](void*) {return 0;}; auto remove=[](void*) {return 0;};
 auto* fakeCtx=reinterpret_cast<ID3D11DeviceContext*>(&fake);
 assert(install(fakeCtx,create,enable,disable,remove) && created==7 && enabled==7 && matches(fakeCtx));
 table[drawSlots[1]]=table[drawSlots[0]]; created=0; enabled=0;
 assert(!matches(fakeCtx) && !install(fakeCtx,create,enable,disable,remove) && created==0 && enabled==0);
}

#pragma once
// Minimal non-Windows COM-shaped API used only by visual_gpu_depth.cpp tests.
#include <cstdint>
#define STDMETHODCALLTYPE
using HRESULT=int; using UINT=unsigned; using INT=int; using FLOAT=float; using ULONG=unsigned;
constexpr HRESULT E_FAIL=-1;
#define SUCCEEDED(x) ((x)>=0)
#define FAILED(x) ((x)<0)
enum D3D11_COMPARISON_FUNC { D3D11_COMPARISON_NEVER=1,D3D11_COMPARISON_LESS=2,D3D11_COMPARISON_EQUAL=3,D3D11_COMPARISON_LESS_EQUAL=4,D3D11_COMPARISON_GREATER=5,D3D11_COMPARISON_GREATER_EQUAL=7,D3D11_COMPARISON_ALWAYS=8 };
enum { D3D11_DEPTH_WRITE_MASK_ZERO=0, D3D11_STENCIL_OP_KEEP=1,
 D3D11_DEFAULT_STENCIL_READ_MASK=255, D3D11_DEFAULT_STENCIL_WRITE_MASK=255,
 D3D11_BLEND_ZERO=1,D3D11_BLEND_ONE=2,D3D11_BLEND_INV_SRC_ALPHA=6,
 D3D11_BLEND_BLEND_FACTOR=14,D3D11_BLEND_INV_BLEND_FACTOR=15,D3D11_BLEND_OP_ADD=1,
 D3D11_COLOR_WRITE_ENABLE_ALL=15 };
constexpr int TRUE=1, FALSE=0;
struct D3D11_DEPTH_STENCILOP_DESC { int StencilFailOp,StencilDepthFailOp,StencilPassOp; D3D11_COMPARISON_FUNC StencilFunc; };
struct D3D11_DEPTH_STENCIL_DESC { int DepthEnable,DepthWriteMask; D3D11_COMPARISON_FUNC DepthFunc; int StencilEnable,StencilReadMask,StencilWriteMask; D3D11_DEPTH_STENCILOP_DESC FrontFace,BackFace; };

#include "../src/visual_depth_policy.h"
#include <cassert>
#include <initializer_list>
int main() {
 using namespace visual_depth_policy;
 assert(!overlayDraw(true) && overlayDraw(false));
 assert(worldDraw(true,true,true,true,true,true));
 assert(!worldDraw(false,true,true,true,true,true));
 assert(!worldDraw(true,false,true,true,true,true));
 assert(!worldDraw(true,true,false,true,true,true));
 assert(!worldDraw(true,true,true,false,true,true));
 assert(!worldDraw(true,true,true,true,false,true));
 assert(!worldDraw(true,true,true,true,true,false));
 assert(playerHat(true,true,true,true,true,false));
 assert(!playerHat(false,true,true,true,true,false));
 assert(!playerHat(true,false,true,true,true,false));
 assert(!playerHat(true,true,false,true,true,false));
 assert(!playerHat(true,true,true,false,true,false));
 assert(!playerHat(true,true,true,true,false,false));
 assert(!playerHat(true,true,true,true,true,true));
 assert(entitiesHat(false) && !entitiesHat(true));
 // Exactly one selected hat path, and trial failure never silently falls
 // back to depth-disabled screen rendering. Trail remains a separate path.
 for (bool strict:{false,true}) for (bool selected:{false,true}) {
  int player=playerHat(strict,selected,true,true,true,false) ? 1 : 0;
  int world=worldDraw(strict,true,true,true,true,true) && entitiesHat(selected) ? 1 : 0;
  int overlay=overlayDraw(strict) ? 1 : 0;
  assert(player+world+overlay==1);
 }
 assert(!playerHat(true,true,true,true,false,false) && !entitiesHat(true) && !overlayDraw(true));
}

#define VISUAL_PLAYER_SKIN_TEST_TYPES "../tests/visual_skin_mock_types.h"
#include "../src/visual_player_skin.h"
#include <cassert>
struct Device:ID3D11Device { int refs=1; ULONG AddRef() override{return ++refs;} ULONG Release() override{return --refs;} };
struct Texture:ID3D11Texture2D {
 int refs=1; D3D11_TEXTURE2D_DESC d{};
 Texture(unsigned w=64,unsigned h=64) {d.Width=w;d.Height=h;d.ArraySize=1;d.SampleDesc.Count=1;}
 ULONG AddRef() override{return ++refs;} ULONG Release() override{return --refs;}
 HRESULT QueryInterface(int,void** out) override {AddRef();*out=this;return 0;}
 void GetDesc(D3D11_TEXTURE2D_DESC* out) override{*out=d;}
};
struct View:ID3D11ShaderResourceView {
 int refs=1; Texture* texture; D3D11_SHADER_RESOURCE_VIEW_DESC d{};
 explicit View(Texture* t):texture(t) {d.Format=DXGI_FORMAT_R8G8B8A8_UNORM;d.ViewDimension=D3D11_SRV_DIMENSION_TEXTURE2D;}
 ULONG AddRef() override{return ++refs;} ULONG Release() override{return --refs;}
 void GetDesc(D3D11_SHADER_RESOURCE_VIEW_DESC* out) override{*out=d;}
 void GetResource(ID3D11Resource** out) override{texture->AddRef();*out=texture;}
};
struct Context:ID3D11DeviceContext {
 Device* device; View* views[4]{};
 explicit Context(Device* d):device(d){}
 void GetDevice(ID3D11Device** out) override {device->AddRef();*out=device;}
 void PSGetShaderResources(UINT start,UINT count,ID3D11ShaderResourceView** out) override {
  assert(start==0 && count==4); for(unsigned i=0;i<count;i++){out[i]=views[i];if(out[i])out[i]->AddRef();}
 }
};
int main() {
 using namespace visual_player_skin;
 Device d,other; Context ctx(&d),wrong(&other);
 Texture t1,t2(64,32),invalid(256,128),atlas(1024,1024); invalid.d.BindFlags=D3D11_BIND_RENDER_TARGET;
 View v1(&t1),v2(&t2),bad(&invalid),big(&atlas); ctx.views[0]=&v1;ctx.views[1]=&v2;ctx.views[2]=&bad;ctx.views[3]=&big;
 observe(&ctx); assert(count==0);
 setRequested(true); begin(42,&ctx); assert(scopeContext==&ctx && d.refs==2);
 observe(&wrong); assert(count==0); observe(&ctx); assert(count==2);
 assert(v1.refs==2 && t1.refs==2 && v2.refs==2 && t2.refs==2 && bad.refs==1 && invalid.refs==1 && big.refs==1);
 observe(&ctx); assert(count==2 && v1.refs==2 && t1.refs==2);
 auto snap=acquire(&d); assert(snap.view==&v1 && snap.width==64 && snap.height==64 && snap.count==2 && v1.refs==3);
 assert(!acquire(&other).view); next(); auto second=acquire(&d); assert(second.view==&v2 && second.height==32 && second.index==1);
 second.view->Release(); end();
 // Changing player clears the old views while the frame-held view stays valid.
 begin(43,&ctx); assert(count==0 && v1.refs==2 && t1.refs==1 && v2.refs==1 && t2.refs==1);
 snap.view->Release(); assert(v1.refs==1); observe(&ctx); assert(count==2); end();
 // Device changes invalidate prior views; they may never be shown to another device.
 begin(43,&wrong); assert(count==0 && d.refs==1 && other.refs==2 && !acquire(&d).view); end();
 setRequested(false); assert(other.refs==1 && !isRequested() && count==0);
 // A capture started before a close/reopen cannot reinsert its old texture.
 setRequested(true); begin(44,&ctx); setRequested(false); setRequested(true);
 observe(&ctx); assert(count==0); end(); begin(44,&ctx); observe(&ctx); assert(count==2); end(); setRequested(false);
 assert(v1.refs==1 && v2.refs==1 && t1.refs==1 && t2.refs==1);
}

#define VISUAL_PLAYER_REPLAY_TEST_TYPES "../tests/visual_replay_mock_types.h"
#include "../src/visual_player_replay.h"
#include <cassert>
#include <cstring>
#include <vector>
static int liveObjects=0;
template<class T> struct Obj:T { int refs=1; Obj(){++liveObjects;} ~Obj(){--liveObjects;} ULONG AddRef() override {return ++refs;} ULONG Release() override {auto r=--refs;if(!r)delete this;return r;} };
struct Device:Obj<ID3D11Device> {
 bool fail=false;
 HRESULT CreateTexture2D(const D3D11_TEXTURE2D_DESC*,void*,ID3D11Texture2D** out) override {if(fail)return -1;*out=new Obj<ID3D11Texture2D>;return 0;}
 HRESULT CreateRenderTargetView(ID3D11Texture2D*,void*,ID3D11RenderTargetView** out) override {*out=new Obj<ID3D11RenderTargetView>;return 0;}
 HRESULT CreateShaderResourceView(ID3D11Texture2D*,void*,ID3D11ShaderResourceView** out) override {*out=new Obj<ID3D11ShaderResourceView>;return 0;}
 HRESULT CreateDepthStencilView(ID3D11Texture2D*,void*,ID3D11DepthStencilView** out) override {*out=new Obj<ID3D11DepthStencilView>;return 0;}
 D3D_FEATURE_LEVEL GetFeatureLevel() override {return D3D_FEATURE_LEVEL_11_0;}
};
struct Depth:Obj<ID3D11DepthStencilState> {D3D11_DEPTH_STENCIL_DESC desc{TRUE,D3D11_COMPARISON_LESS,FALSE}; void GetDesc(D3D11_DEPTH_STENCIL_DESC* d) override {*d=desc;} };
struct Context:ID3D11DeviceContext {
 unsigned refs=1;
 ULONG AddRef() override { return ++refs; }
 ULONG Release() override { assert(refs>1); return --refs; }
 Device* device=new Device; Depth* depth=new Depth;
 ID3D11RenderTargetView* target=new Obj<ID3D11RenderTargetView>;
 ID3D11DepthStencilView* dsv=new Obj<ID3D11DepthStencilView>;
 ID3D11RenderTargetView* curTarget=target; ID3D11DepthStencilView* curDsv=dsv;
 ID3D11ShaderResourceView* bound=nullptr; ID3D11UnorderedAccessView* uav=nullptr; ID3D11Buffer* so=nullptr; ID3D11Predicate* pred=nullptr;
 D3D11_VIEWPORT viewport{0,0,1920,1080,0,1}; D3D11_RECT scissors{1,2,3,4}; UINT views=1,scissorCount=1; int sets=0,clears=0,depthClears=0;
 ~Context(){device->Release();depth->Release();target->Release();dsv->Release();if(uav)uav->Release();if(so)so->Release();if(pred)pred->Release();}
 void shader(UINT,UINT n,ID3D11ShaderResourceView** out) {for(UINT i=0;i<n;i++)out[i]=nullptr;if(bound){out[0]=bound;bound->AddRef();}}
 void VSGetShaderResources(UINT a,UINT b,ID3D11ShaderResourceView** c) override {shader(a,b,c);}
 void HSGetShaderResources(UINT a,UINT b,ID3D11ShaderResourceView** c) override {shader(a,b,c);}
 void DSGetShaderResources(UINT a,UINT b,ID3D11ShaderResourceView** c) override {shader(a,b,c);}
 void GSGetShaderResources(UINT a,UINT b,ID3D11ShaderResourceView** c) override {shader(a,b,c);}
 void PSGetShaderResources(UINT a,UINT b,ID3D11ShaderResourceView** c) override {shader(a,b,c);}
 void CSGetShaderResources(UINT a,UINT b,ID3D11ShaderResourceView** c) override {shader(a,b,c);}
 void GetDevice(ID3D11Device** o) override {*o=device;device->AddRef();}
 void ClearRenderTargetView(ID3D11RenderTargetView*,const FLOAT[4]) override {clears++;}
 void RSGetViewports(UINT* n,D3D11_VIEWPORT* o) override {if(o && *n>0)*o=viewport;*n=views;}
 void OMGetDepthStencilState(ID3D11DepthStencilState** o,UINT* s) override {*o=depth;depth->AddRef();*s=0;}
 void OMGetRenderTargets(UINT n,ID3D11RenderTargetView** o,ID3D11DepthStencilView** v) override {for(UINT i=0;i<n;i++)o[i]=nullptr;o[0]=curTarget;if(curTarget)curTarget->AddRef();*v=curDsv;if(curDsv)curDsv->AddRef();}
 void SOGetTargets(UINT n,ID3D11Buffer** o) override {for(UINT i=0;i<n;i++)o[i]=nullptr;if(so){o[0]=so;so->AddRef();}}
 void GetPredication(ID3D11Predicate** o,BOOL* b) override {*o=pred;*b=FALSE;if(pred)pred->AddRef();}
 void OMGetRenderTargetsAndUnorderedAccessViews(UINT,ID3D11RenderTargetView**,ID3D11DepthStencilView**,UINT,UINT n,ID3D11UnorderedAccessView** o) override {for(UINT i=0;i<n;i++)o[i]=nullptr;if(uav){o[0]=uav;uav->AddRef();}}
 void ClearDepthStencilView(ID3D11DepthStencilView*,UINT,float,UINT) override {depthClears++;}
 void RSGetScissorRects(UINT* n,D3D11_RECT* o) override {if(*n>0 && scissorCount)*o=scissors;*n=scissorCount;}
 void OMSetRenderTargets(UINT n,ID3D11RenderTargetView* const* o,ID3D11DepthStencilView* v) override {assert(n==1 || n==8);assert(o[0] && v);curTarget=o[0];curDsv=v;sets++;}
 void RSSetViewports(UINT n,const D3D11_VIEWPORT* v) override {assert(n==1);viewport=*v;sets++;}
 void RSSetScissorRects(UINT n,const D3D11_RECT* r) override {assert(n==1 || n==0);scissorCount=n;if(n)scissors=*r;sets++;}
};
int main() {
 using namespace visual_player_replay;
 {
  Context c;
  begin(1,&c); assert(!scope.ctx && c.clears==0);
  setRequested(true); begin(1,&c); assert(scope.ctx==&c && c.refs==2 && c.clears==1 && !acquire(c.device));
  const auto oldViewport=c.viewport; const auto oldScissor=c.scissors;
  assert(beginDraw(&c) && saved.active && c.sets==3 && c.depthClears==1);
  assert(c.curTarget==scope.rtv && c.curDsv==scope.dsv && c.viewport.Height==768 && c.scissors.right==256);
  endDraw(&c); assert(!saved.active && c.sets==6 && scope.draws==1);
  assert(c.curTarget==c.target && c.curDsv==c.dsv && std::memcmp(&oldViewport,&c.viewport,sizeof(oldViewport))==0 && std::memcmp(&oldScissor,&c.scissors,sizeof(oldScissor))==0);
  end(); assert(c.refs==1); auto* image=acquire(c.device); assert(image); image->Release();
  mockTick+=2001; assert(!acquire(c.device)); mockTick=100;
  // A view bound for reading prevents any clear or target mutation.
  c.bound=targets[1].srv; const int clears=c.clears; begin(1,&c); assert(!scope.ctx && c.clears==clears); c.bound=nullptr;
  begin(1,&c); assert(scope.index==1); c.depth->desc.StencilEnable=TRUE;
  assert(!beginDraw(&c) && c.sets==6); c.depth->desc.StencilEnable=FALSE;
  c.uav=new Obj<ID3D11UnorderedAccessView>; assert(!beginDraw(&c)); c.uav->Release(); c.uav=nullptr;
  c.so=new Obj<ID3D11Buffer>; assert(!beginDraw(&c)); c.so->Release(); c.so=nullptr;
  c.pred=new Obj<ID3D11Predicate>; assert(!beginDraw(&c)); c.pred->Release(); c.pred=nullptr;
  c.views=2; assert(!beginDraw(&c)); c.views=1;
  assert(beginDraw(&c)); endDraw(&c);
  c.depth->desc.DepthFunc=D3D11_COMPARISON_GREATER; assert(!beginDraw(&c)); c.depth->desc.DepthFunc=D3D11_COMPARISON_LESS; end();
  auto* held=acquire(c.device); assert(held);
  // Closing while a frame holds a view leaves that view alive, but removes it
  // from future snapshots; reopening cannot publish an old scoped capture.
  begin(1,&c); assert(beginDraw(&c)); endDraw(&c); setRequested(false); setRequested(true); end();
  assert(!acquire(c.device)); held->Release();
  // Device creation failure is fail-closed and isn't retried each frame.
  setRequested(false); c.device->fail=true; setRequested(true); begin(1,&c); assert(!scope.ctx && creationFailed);
  c.device->fail=false; begin(1,&c); assert(!scope.ctx && creationFailed);
  setRequested(false); setRequested(true); begin(2,&c); assert(scope.ctx); end(); setRequested(false);
  assert(c.refs==1); assert(liveObjects==4); // context-owned device, depth, world render target and DSV
 }
 assert(liveObjects==0);
}

#include "../src/visual_hooks.h"
#include <cassert>
#include <cstdint>
using namespace visual_hooks;
struct Fake {
 int failCreate=0,failEnable=0,failDisable=0,created=0,enabled=0,disabled=0,removed=0,active=0;
 static int bit(void* p) { return 1<<static_cast<int>(reinterpret_cast<std::uintptr_t>(p)-1); }
 int create(void* target,void*,void**) { int b=bit(target); if (failCreate&b) return 1; created|=b; return 0; }
 int enable(void* target) { int b=bit(target); if (failEnable&b) return 1; enabled|=b; active|=b; return 0; }
 int disable(void* target) { int b=bit(target); disabled|=b; if (failDisable&b) return 1; active&=~b; return 0; }
 int remove(void* target) { int b=bit(target); assert(!(active&b)); removed|=b; return 0; }
};
bool run(Fake& f) {
 void* tramp[3]{}; Hook hooks[3]{};
 for (int i=0;i<3;i++) hooks[i]={reinterpret_cast<void*>(static_cast<std::uintptr_t>(i+1)),reinterpret_cast<void*>(10),&tramp[i]};
 return install(hooks,3,[&](auto a,auto b,auto c){return f.create(a,b,c);},
   [&](auto a){return f.enable(a);},[&](auto a){return f.disable(a);},[&](auto a){return f.remove(a);});
}
int main() {
 Fake ok; assert(run(ok)); assert(ok.created==7 && ok.enabled==7 && ok.disabled==0 && ok.removed==0 && ok.active==7);
 Fake create; create.failCreate=4; assert(!run(create)); assert(create.created==3 && create.enabled==0 && create.removed==3);
 Fake partial; partial.failEnable=4; assert(!run(partial)); assert(partial.enabled==3 && partial.disabled==3 && partial.removed==7 && partial.active==0);
 Fake failure; failure.failEnable=4; failure.failDisable=2; assert(!run(failure));
 assert(failure.enabled==3 && failure.disabled==3 && failure.removed==5 && failure.active==2);
 // Seven D3D draw targets: a partial enable failure must disable/remove every
 // earlier active hook and remove every created but inactive hook.
 Fake gpu; gpu.failEnable=1<<5; void* tramp[7]{}; Hook hooks[7]{};
 for (int i=0;i<7;i++) hooks[i]={reinterpret_cast<void*>(static_cast<std::uintptr_t>(i+1)),reinterpret_cast<void*>(10),&tramp[i]};
 assert(!install(hooks,7,[&](auto a,auto b,auto c){return gpu.create(a,b,c);},
   [&](auto a){return gpu.enable(a);},[&](auto a){return gpu.disable(a);},[&](auto a){return gpu.remove(a);}));
 assert(gpu.created==127 && gpu.enabled==31 && gpu.disabled==31 && gpu.removed==127 && gpu.active==0);
}

НАЧАЛО ФАЙЛА: repair/src/visual_jump.h
